blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Authorities safely captured a venomous Philippine cobra found on the premises of a public high school in Tayabas City, Quezon, on Tuesday afternoon. The snake was captured at 1:17 p.m. at the Buenaventura Alandy National High School, the Tayabas City Environment and Natural Resources Office (ENRO) said in a Wednesday report. The reptile was subsequently turned over to the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR) Community Environment and Natural Resources Office (CENRO) for proper assessment and disposition.
